newsitem.title: UK: HSBC firm as Hang Seng hits new record.
newsitem.headline: HSBC firm as Hang Seng hits new record.

text.p: Shares in HSBC Holdings Plc jumped Friday morning, tracking the strong performance of the banking sector in Hong Kong.
By 0750 GMT the stock was up 38p to 18.87-1/2 stg.
In Hong Kong the Hang Seng soared 4.26 percent to 15,124.51 points, touching a new all-time high of 15,139.04 points as pre-handover euphoria swept through the market.
HSBC Holdings in Hong Kong rose HK$6 to HK$ 232.
Hank Seng Bank led the strong surge of the banking sector on rumours that after the handover a mainland company could buy a stake in the bank. The stock was up HK$12.75 to HK$109.50.
HSBC dismissed the talk, saying it had no plans to change its shareholding in the subsidiary.
Elsewhere, Standard & Chartered Plc rose 11p to 910-1/2p.
